name: relentless-data-skills
description: A collection of agent skills maintained by Relentless Data — each skill installs independently.

plugins.name: implement-issue
plugins.description: Implement a GitHub issue end-to-end: claim it, branch, code in small commits, run tests + a runtime smoke check, and open a draft PR — with explicit stop conditions instead of improvising.

plugins.name: prefect-skill
plugins.description: Opinionated Prefect 3 guidance: greenfield scaffolding, existing-project audit, and a live docs-lookup protocol. Prefect 2.x out of scope.

plugins.name: smart-git-commit
plugins.description: Groups changed files by affected area, creates one conventional commit per group, then pushes to remote — conventional commit format with lowercase type prefixes.

plugins.name: visual-report
plugins.description: Produce a single self-contained HTML visual report — an explainer, writeup, or diagram-heavy document built with Tailwind + Mermaid via CDN plus hand-crafted CSS/SVG. Use when you want a shareable single-file visual writeup of a system, process, or findings.

plugins.name: orchestrator-mode
plugins.description: Forces the main thread to act as an orchestrator and delegate ALL work to subagents instead of doing it itself — plan, dispatch, verify with a separate agent, synthesize. Agent-neutral across Claude Code and Cursor.

plugins.name: dlt-bootstrap
plugins.description: Bootstrap a dlt ingestion project: install the dltHub AI Workbench project-scoped, then layer Relentless Data house conventions (Snowflake, Prefect, DuckDB dev loop) as a committed always-on rule.

plugins.name: snowman
plugins.description: Read-only Snowflake exploration via the snow CLI — schema discovery, profiling, hypothesis testing, and data-quality investigation. Bootstraps a committed per-project context; a guardrail wrapper hard-enforces read-only.
